sql: WITH venue_summary AS (SELECT venue, ROUND(AVG(first_ings_score), 2) AS avg_first_innings_score FROM ipl GROUP BY venue), sample_rows AS (SELECT * FROM ipl LIMIT 5) SELECT vs.venue, vs.avg_first_innings_score, sr.match_id, sr.team1, sr.team2 FROM venue_summary vs LEFT JOIN sample_rows sr ON vs.venue = sr.venue

query: calculate the average bowling strike of CSK thorughout the season using the IPL uploaded dataset
sql: SELECT 'Chennai Super Kings' AS team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played, COUNT(*) * 120 AS total_balls_bowled, SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(best_bowling_figure, 1, INSTR(best_bowling_figure, '--') - 1) AS INTEGER)) AS wickets_taken, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) * 120 AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(best_bowling_figure, 1, INSTR(best_bowling_figure, '--') - 1) AS INTEGER)), 0), 2) AS average_bowling_strike_rate, SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(best_bowling_figure, INSTR(best_bowling_figure, '--') + 2) AS NUMERIC)) AS runs_conceded, ROUND(SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(best_bowling_figure, INSTR(best_bowling_figure, '--') + 2) AS NUMERIC)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(SUBSTR(best_bowling_figure, 1, INSTR(best_bowling_figure, '--') - 1) AS INTEGER)), 0), 2) AS bowling_average FROM ipl WHERE (team1 = 'Chennai Super Kings' OR team2 = 'Chennai Super Kings') AND best_bowling_figure LIKE '%--%';
